verses.t: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense
verses.pickthall: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion

verses.t: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
verses.pickthall: That is he who repelleth the orphan

verses.t: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor
verses.pickthall: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy

verses.t: So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer
verses.pickthall: Who are heedless of their prayer

verses.t: Those who make show [of their deeds]
